title: Infineon Offers Evaluation Samples of AI Power Semiconductors: 6 mm Square with 300 A Peak
excerpt: On September 7, 2026, Infineon announced the TDA235E5 and TDA235E0 power semiconductors for AI. We explain the 6 mm square, 300 A peak specs, how vertical power delivery works, the difference between evaluation samples and mass production, and what to check next.
